scope: Existing authorized core publishing work; no Network, Federation, ActivityPub or platform-core installation authority
authority: Phil's October 12 direction to implement the existing component work list and build, with no new platform-core integration enabled by default

authentication.authority: Authenticated Content Connection and native permissions; descriptive adapter labels never grant scope

compatibility.legacy_resolve_without_source_publicatio: Identity resolution only; never rewrite the topic as an incidental retry
compatibility.legacy_inline_content: Unnegotiated eligible-source inventory and detail retain their existing inline body
compatibility.privacy: Native source eligibility is enforced regardless of client version

active_source.created_at: Native first-post creation time, ISO8601 with timezone; never mapping or synchronization time
active_source.updated_at: Native first-post edit time, including title edits saved by native PostRevisor, ISO8601 with timezone; unrelated replies, bumps or topic saves never move source-modified Latest
active_source.forum_name: Effective DISCUSSIONBRIDGE_FORUM_NAME/native DiscussionBridge setting; absent override falls back to the native forum title
active_source.forum_name_validation: Nonempty after trimming; valid UTF8; no control characters; always escaped by the rendering destination
active_source.edition: Lowercase 64-character SHA256 of one coherent native source edition; includes title, raw/cooked content, native identity/dates, source author and effective forum name
active_source.edition_encoding: UTF8 JSON array in the declared order; dates UTC ISO8601(6); missing values remain explicit null; hash lowercase SHA256
active_source.edition_authority: Native coherent source read; source edition is descriptive freshness evidence, not authorization

content.bytes: Positive safe integer: exact UTF8 byte length of the complete cooked source
content.sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of complete cooked-source UTF8 bytes before destination sanitization

withdrawn_source.title: Source publication withdrawn
withdrawn_source.edition: SHA256 of the withdrawal identity/state edition; private title, body and author are excluded
withdrawn_source.source_rules: Private/PM/deleted/unavailable sources and known externally derived To-Discourse first posts cannot be publicly materialized as original forum content; negotiated inventory carries withdrawal for already scoped records. Ordinary quotes do not establish foreign ownership
withdrawn_source.destination_rules: Withdraw only an exactly owned native materialization from public rendering; retain its native identity and recovery state
withdrawn_source.failure_rules: Missing records, authentication failures and network failures do not themselves authorize withdrawal
withdrawn_source.static_completion: A local edit is pending until the configured build/deployment and public verification confirm withdrawal

query.offset: Required integer UTF8 byte offset, zero or positive and less than total bytes

content_transport.next_offset: Exact following byte offset, or null only when total_bytes has been consumed
content_transport.unavailable: Fail closed without a content body
content_transport.validation: Exact resource/edition/offset, strict base64, declared chunk and total lengths, complete-content SHA256 and final valid UTF8
content_transport.redirects: Refuse redirects; derive and verify the exact same authenticated forum origin and resource path
content_transport.publication_size: Chunk and metadata bounds are transport bounds, never a universal publication-size cap; destination-native limitations govern any required excerpt

presentation_binding.absent_or_null: Use the destination's existing operator selection
presentation_binding.existing_native_selection: Preserve an existing explicit operator selection across source revisions
presentation_binding.direction: From Discourse is a direction, not a discussion presentation mode

source_publication.previous_revision: Required null for first claim/adoption or lowercase SHA256 of the last accepted source publication
source_publication.created_at: Required key: authoritative native source creation time with timezone, or explicit null where no native timestamp exists; never substitute checkout, binding or synchronization time
source_publication.updated_at: Required key: authoritative native source edit time with timezone, or explicit null where unavailable; validate no earlier than creation only when both times are known
source_publication.content_sha256: Required lowercase SHA256 of complete portable source HTML before excerpting
source_publication.content_bytes: Required positive safe integer giving complete portable source UTF8 bytes
source_publication.excerpted: Required boolean; false requires payload body length/hash equality, true describes a valid HTML excerpt with canonical Read More

to_discourse.revision_identity: A change to source title/content/authorship/native dates produces a new SHA256 edition; exact identical source editions retain their revision
to_discourse.initial_claim: Create only within the existing authenticated source connection and native authorization; persist exact source publication and managed-native fingerprint
to_discourse.exact_retry: Same accepted source revision returns resolved without rewriting native content; conflicting metadata for that revision is rejected
to_discourse.update: A different source revision requires previous_revision to equal stored revision and the current managed-native fingerprint to match; native PostRevisor updates the same owned first post/topic
to_discourse.stale_update: Return reconciliation_required; never overwrite a later accepted publication
to_discourse.legacy_adoption: With no stored publication metadata, initialize only when source title, decorated raw content and author exactly match the owned native topic/post; adoption changes no body bytes. Other cases require explicit reconciliation
to_discourse.managed_native_sha256: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 JSON array [topic.id, topic.title, first_post.id, first_post.raw, first_post.user_id]; cooked/rebake output is excluded
to_discourse.request_sha256: Internal receipt only: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 JSON array [request.title, request.content_html, ordered normalized author arrays [id,name,profile_url-or-null], primary_source_author_id]; previous_revision is a precondition, not edition metadata
to_discourse.oversized_content: Preserve complete native source; send a valid HTML excerpt within 48KiB with Read More to its canonical platform source; digest/length describe the complete source

destination_state.publicly_verified_at: Actual successful public verification time; never inferred from a save/build
destination_state.failure: Specific bounded reason, preserved retry/recovery state, no success after failed identity persistence
destination_state.identity: Resource, topic, native object and canonical platform/binding URL remain stable across source editions, retries, withdrawal and restoration
destination_state.native_topic_url: Native Discourse slug URL may change with title edits; accept only a strict same-origin topic path identifying the same authoritative topic ID. Updating this location does not migrate the canonical platform/binding URL

installation.activation: Inert/default-off until the operator configures and authorizes publication
installation.templates_and_rich_assets: Explicit operator selection; no automatic insertion into platform core, theme, layout or default build
installation.upgrades: Preserve existing working renderer/template choices, native content and custom operator assets; absence of a new option is not deliberate disablement
installation.new_features: No Network, Federation, ActivityPub, catalog-based grants or unrelated publication authority
